enhancement_strength.description: Enhancement strength for generative upscaling. Applies to Wonder 3 and Wonder 3.5 models. When omitted, Topaz auto-configures it.
enhancement_strength.title: Enhancement Strength

face_enhancement_creativity.description: Creativity level for face enhancement. 0.0 means no creativity, 1.0 means maximum creativity. Ignored if face enhancement is disabled.
face_enhancement_creativity.title: Face Enhancement Creativity

detail.description: Detail recovery level (0.0-1.0). Applies to Recovery V2 model only.
detail.title: Detail

autoprompt.description: Enable automatic prompt generation for generative upscaling. Applies to Redefine model only.
autoprompt.title: Autoprompt

upscale_factor.description: Factor to upscale the image by (e.g. 2.0 doubles width and height)
upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor

creativity.description: Creativity level for generative upscaling (1-6). Higher values produce more creative/hallucinated details. Applies to Redefine model only.
creativity.title: Creativity

texture.description: Texture detail level for generative upscaling (1-5). Applies to Redefine model only.
texture.title: Texture

image_url.description: Url of the image to be upscaled
image_url.title: Image Url

prompt.description: Text prompt to guide generative upscaling (max 1024 chars). Applies to Redefine model only.
prompt.title: Prompt

subject_detection.description: Subject detection mode for the image enhancement. Applies to Wonder 3, Recovery and Recovery V2 models.
subject_detection.title: Subject Detection

model.description: Generative upscaling model. Wonder 3.5 is the latest Wonder with finer detail and fewer repetitive patterns; Wonder 3 is Topaz's most advanced generative realism model (Wonder 2/Wonder are earlier generations); Recover 3 rebuilds natural detail; Standard MAX is high-quality precision-leaning upscaling; Redefine adds prompt-guided creative detail; Recovery and Recovery V2 rebuild extreme low-resolution images.
model.title: Model

sharpen.description: Sharpening level (0.0-1.0). Applies to Redefine model only.
sharpen.title: Sharpen

output_format.description: Output format of the upscaled image.
output_format.title: Output Format

face_enhancement_strength.description: Strength of the face enhancement. 0.0 means no enhancement, 1.0 means maximum enhancement. Ignored if face enhancement is disabled.
face_enhancement_strength.title: Face Enhancement Strength

face_enhancement.description: Whether to apply face enhancement to the image.
face_enhancement.title: Face Enhancement

denoise.description: Denoising level (0.0-1.0). Applies to Redefine model only.
denoise.title: Denoise

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url
